items: Which dynasty ruled Telangana from Warangal and is most associated with its identity? Answer: Kakatiya Dynasty
Who built the Ramappa Temple, which became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021? Answer: General Recharla Rudra under Kakatiya king Ganapati Deva (1213 CE)
What is the significance of September 17, 1948 in Telangana's history? Answer: Indian Army launched Operation Polo (Police Action), leading to liberation/integration of Hyderabad State into India
Name the last ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. Answer: Abul Hasan Tana Shah (defeated by Aurangzeb in 1687)
When was Charminar built and by whom? Answer: 1591 CE by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah
Who is known as the ideologue of the Telangana movement and coined the phrase 'Telangana Thalli'? Answer: Professor M. Kodandaram (Jayashankar Sir)
What is Perini Shivatandavam? Who revived it? Answer: Ancient vigorous masculine dance form from Kakatiya period; revived by Dr. Nataraja Ramakrishna
Which festival is called the 'World's Largest Tribal Fair'? Answer: Sammakka-Saralamma Jatara held at Medaram, Mulugu district, every two years
Which river is the longest flowing through Telangana? Answer: Godavari
What is the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Scheme known for? Answer: World's largest multi-stage lift irrigation project; lifts water from Godavari river
Which district of Telangana hosts the largest turmeric market in Asia? Answer: Nizamabad
Name the Tiger Reserve that is the largest by area in India. Answer: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve
What is the specialty of Pochampally village? Answer: Pochampally Ikat silk weaving – a GI-tagged handloom product
When was Telangana formed and what number state is it? Answer: June 2, 2014; India's 29th state
How many seats does the Telangana Legislative Assembly have? Answer: 119 seats
What is Dharani Portal? Answer: An integrated land records and registration management portal launched by Telangana government in 2020
Name the paramilitary force of Telangana Police specializing in counter-terrorism. Answer: OCTOPUS (Organisation for Counter Terrorist Operations)
What is TS-iPASS? Answer: Telangana Industrial Project Approval and Self-Certification System – Single window clearance for industrial projects
Who was the first Prime Minister of India from Telangana? Answer: P.V. Narasimha Rao (born in Karimnagar district; PM 1991–96)
